hookups.source: https://www.pa.gov/agencies/dcnr/recreation/where-to-go/state-parks/find-a-park/french-creek-state-park/stay ('Electric hookups: 60+, some sites have full-hookup with sewer, water, and electricity') + ReserveAmerica per-site catalog for parkId 880406 (44 Full-Hookup sites list 50-amp, water and sewer; 41 Modern Electric list 50-amp), read 2026-10-20

values.note: 195 campsites on the booking site (110 Modern Non-Electric, 41 Modern Electric, 44 Full-Hookup) besides cottages, cabins, yurts and glamping. Listed max vehicle lengths are mostly 45-50 ft, with 17 Loop A full-hookup sites at 55-75 ft. Every site is listed back-in.

sites.source: https://pennsylvaniastateparks.reserveamerica.com/camping/french-creek-state-park/r/campgroundDetails.do?contractCode=PA&parkId=880406 (site list and each site's details page: Max Vehicle Length, Driveway Entry), read 2026-10-20

values.note: Campsites can be booked up to 11 months ahead and for the same day (ReserveAmerica booking window). Pets on A and C loops only. Glamping sites are booked through Timberline Glamping, not ReserveAmerica.

booking.source: https://pennsylvaniastateparks.reserveamerica.com/camping/french-creek-state-park/r/campgroundDetails.do?contractCode=PA&parkId=880406 (Booking Window: 'Reservations can be made for today and can be made up to 11 Month(s) in advance') + the DCNR stay page ('Pet-friendly: A loop and C loop only'), read 2026-10-20

summary: Confirmed inherited reservable/ReserveAmerica/11-month window; season already manual (March to first weekend of January). Added 50-amp electric with water+sewer at 44 full-hookup sites, 195 sites (45-75 ft, all back-in), showers/flush toilets. Not stated for this park: minimum/maximum stay, noon cutoff, fcfs, dump station. Fees left at the statewide table.
flags: website carries an aggregator link (https://www.campsitephotos.com/campground/pa/french-creek-state-park/); replace with the DCNR park page https://www.pa.gov/agencies/dcnr/recreation/where-to-go/state-parks/find-a-park/french-creek-state-park.
